class.comment: Generate the resource-aware authorization administration and evaluation engine. Register Tenant Resources while treating the host Tenant Adapter as authoritative for current Tenant ownership and parentage; validate Role definitions and User/Service Role Memberships within Tenant boundaries; validate Grants targeting exactly one known User, Service, Role, or API Key and one known Tenant Resource while preserving exact case-sensitive Permission Keys; walk from the requested resource toward ancestors until root or inheritance protection; include only enabled, unexpired, unrevoked contributions; apply Deny precedence over Allow; expose a non-authorizing Grant Catalog; reject cycles, cross-Tenant ancestry, invalid memberships, and unknown principals/resources; and invalidate affected cached decisions before the next authorization after Grant, membership, Role, User, Service, API Key, or Tenant Resource parent changes. Successful API Key authentication produces the active owner's effective allowed Scopes plus direct API Key Grants, with all effective Deny Grants taking precedence; direct Scope input is persisted as Grant records rather than a parallel permission store.
class.name: SecurityAuthorityAuthorizationEngine
